StudioCloudProject.title: StudioCloudProject
StudioCloudProject.description: Represents a saved Moshtaq Grafx AI Studio mockup or commercial design project synced to Firestore for a specific authenticated designer.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this studio project.

title.description: Project title or mockup category title in Arabic.

categoryTitleAr.description: Arabic name of the selected mockup or design category.

processingModeAr.description: Arabic label of the identity preservation or AI enhancement processing mode.

savedFilePath.description: Local file path of the exported high-resolution asset on the device.

notesAr.description: Optional designer notes or AI analysis summary in Arabic.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Per-user subcollection storing Moshtaq Grafx AI Studio project records isolated by authenticated userId.
